summary: Describes the state of standardization of Internet protocols as determined by the IAB. It explains the standards process and RFC series, defines terms, and lists protocols at each stage. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 1250.

eli5.summary: It is the official scoreboard of which Internet rules were finished and which were still being worked on. It has been replaced by a newer scoreboard.

questions: what is the iab official protocol standards list
